sentences.en: Inviolable gender roles are a form of authoritarianism.
sentences.zh: 不可侵犯的性别角色是一种专制主义。

sentences.en: Strict and inviolable gender roles have been fundamental to authoritarian regimes throughout history.
sentences.zh: 严格的、不容侵犯的性别角色一直是历史上专制政权的基础。

sentences.en: The national sovereignty is sacred and inviolable.
sentences.zh: 国家主权神圣不可侵犯。

senses.zh: 不可侵犯的；不可亵渎的；神圣的
